subject.title: [Feature Request] Unified Built-in Sandbox with Multi-Platform Support and Tiered Presets

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical sandbox/isolation tracker, or split it now into separate milestones for default presets, plugin/process isolation, IPC proxying, manifest policy, credential scoping, and resource limits?
rationale: The unresolved work defines OpenClaw's security boundary and public config/plugin contracts, and current source plus release inspection shows only partial opt-in tool sandbox groundwork.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker, then create maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin Isolation
options.body: Scope this issue to native plugin/process and credential isolation, leaving tool-level sandboxing and filesystem policy to existing narrower issues.

options.title: Defer Broad Architecture
options.body: Continue supporting current opt-in tool sandboxing while freezing broader secure-by-default work until a maintainer sponsors the product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker, then create maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the live tracker discussion and recent sandbox/config/docs history.
